_purpose: Live status. Update as work lands. Never mark a phase 'done' without the verification evidence.
_ON_DEVICE_2026-07-24: FIRST real hardware run of :universal-printer (+ search). Device: ZC-3588A (Rockchip RK3588, Android 12) at 192.168.80.39 via wireless adb — a GENERIC box, NOT Sunmi/iMin/Star, so built-in backends untested. VERIFIED on hardware: (1) example app builds+installs+launches, Compose UI renders (screenshot). (2) Network discovery works end-to-end — SNMP-enriched TCP-9100 /24 scan found a real Epson print server at 192.168.80.168 (brand=EPSON, name, mac=38:1A:52:D8:2D:3A, serial=XD6C001245). (3) NETWORK ESC/POS PRINT SUCCEEDED — pointed example Print->Net at .168, printer.print(sampleReceipt) returned PrintResult.Success ('Net .168: printed'). This exercises connect+4s-timeout + DLE EOT preflight (did not block) + EscPosRenderer + DantSu TCP write on real hardware => network print path moves ASSUMED->VERIFIED at SDK/protocol level. CAVEAT: 'Success' = printer accepted the job + write completed; PHYSICAL paper appearance (column alignment, inverted header, QR scannability) is USER-to-confirm, not observed from adb. STILL ASSUMED: PrintType.IMAGE (HTML->WebView->bitmap) never run; Sunmi/iMin/Star/USB backends (no such hardware). NOTE: example MainActivity Print->Net IP changed 192.168.80.27 -> 192.168.80.168 (the discovered printer).

PrinterBrand += STAR/ZEBRA/BIXOLON/CITIZEN/BROTHER. Example: SNMP + Zebra buttons. VERIFIED BUILD SUCCESSFUL + testDebugUnitTest tests=10 failures=0 (brand-mapping + Zebra offset-parsing). Coverage: Epson(ENPC), Sunmi(mDNS), Zebra(UDP-4201), Star/Bixolon/Citizen/Brother/Seiko(SNMP), generic(TCP-9100 SNMP-enriched), USB. ASSUMED (NOT hardware-verified): sysDescr brand tokens, SNMP community 'public', Zebra request bytes/offsets. --- PRIOR (D7): SEIKO RP-series discovery ADDED SDK-free via SNMP (decision D7). New network/seiko/ package: Snmp.kt (hand-rolled SNMPv1 BER codec, no snmp4j) + SnmpClient.kt (UDP/161 GET) + SeikoSnmpProbe.kt (standard MIB OIDs + brand-token match) + SeikoDiscovery.kt (reuses NetworkScanner /24 sweep -> per-host SNMP identify). Wired into facade (discoverSeikoPrinters/probeSeiko/discoverAll) + PrinterBrand.SEIKO + example Seiko button. VERIFIED BUILD SUCCESSFUL (:universal-printer-search + :example assembleDebug) and SnmpTest tests=5 failures=0. Coverage now: Epson (ENPC/UDP + GS I), Sunmi (mDNS), Seiko RP (SNMP), generic IP (TCP-9100), USB. ASSUMED (NOT hardware-verified): that RP printers answer SNMP community 'public' and return a Seiko token + serial at the standard OIDs. NEXT: on-device runtime verification against a real RP printer.
